race.comment: MONT SAINT MICHEL (4) will certainly not be in the reckoning in the early stages given his pattern but does finish fast. He probably wants it to be a good surface to do so but watch him over the concluding stages. ZE BEE NINE (6) is one who could take up a forward spot like at Bairnsdale and might want to do that to offset the wide barrier. Needs that share of luck. OCEAN'S JEN (5) is the one who brings in the best recent form lines. But they came from running in far different places. Betting is the best guide to her. GATSBY CROWN (3) only battled away last time but that came after a solid effort at Donald. Could they go back to leading? RUBY AVENUE (1) is rock hard fit and once again draws a low gate. Can get into the placings.
